title: 第一章 我们之中出了一个叛徒第二章 无间道
lines: 大顺995年，蜀中，长乐郡，龙兴县，前村。
冬日严寒，萧瑟的秋风到了此时已经日渐严酷，宛若一口口无形的刀剑，不断劈斩着大地上的生机。
然而即便如此，到了清晨时分，前村的黔首们还是纷纷裹紧身上的衣物，推开门，顶着苦寒走出了屋子，他们有的决心上山砍柴，有的决心去附近的龙兴县城碰碰运气，看看能否找到个工作。
泥泞的村道中，人们汇聚而来。
他们没有开口，哪怕是街坊邻里，碰了面也就是彼此点头示意，只因一说话就会被灌入冷冽的寒风。
偌大的村庄，鸦雀无声。
只有黔首们沉默的走路声，以及寒风吹拂的猎猎声，整个村庄仿佛一头冻死的野兽匍匐在山林深处。
人群来到村口后，就各奔东西，有的人去了后山，有的人去了县城，还有一部分人则是往村北走去。
那里立着一座道观。
道观外表看上去并不大，甚至可以说得上是简陋，然而靠近之后却能感觉到一股灼热之风扑面而来。
走进道观后，就能看到正中间摆放着一座巨大香炉，大量的焦石被投入其中，点火，而后带起冲天的热气，驱散了严冬的寒冷，道观内传出的人声更是让其成为了这片严冬中唯一的生机之地。
几个前村村民走进道观，顿时畅快地长叹一声，随后就见一位身披道袍的青年男子从后院走了出来。
“都到齐了？”青年道人问道。
“见过谢师兄。”
村民们纷纷行礼，表情带着说不出的狂热，双手十指交缠，结出了一枚莲花状的手印，口中赞颂道：
“莲华降世，普度众生。”
青年道人闻言也双手结印，回了一礼，这才继续说道：“师傅已经等候你们多时了，都跟我进来吧。”
众人就这样进了后院，却见里面足足有十几个正值壮年的男子，身材和小牛犊子似的，显然是一日三餐顿顿有肉，正在操练演武，一边打拳一边中气十足地嘿嘿哈哈，肆意挥洒着青春和汗水。
而负责带领他们的，则是一位年轻人。
只见他赤裸着上身，汗水从肩背滚落，皮肤在阳光下显出古铜色的光泽，轮廓清晰，面庞俊秀清逸。
“师弟，停一下。”
青年道人高声说道，然而年轻人却没有回应，反而愣在原地，似乎陷入了回忆，许久都没有回过神。
“师弟？”青年道人见状有些好奇。
王平摇了摇头，驱散眼底的茫然，很快振作起来，笑道：“师傅他老人家回来了，而且还要见我们？”
“是啊。”
青年道人笑道：“师弟你一直帮忙组织前村的教众，任劳任怨，功劳不小，师傅就是为了你回来的。”
“师弟你的好日子就要来了！”
王平闻言顿时露出了喜悦之色。
然而心底深处，他的情绪却毫无波动，甚至还有点想笑——古代王朝，封建社会，能有什么好日子？
能活着，已是邀天之幸。
穿越至今二十年，他也在这个名为“大顺”的破地方苟且偷生了二十年，彻底融入了这里的生活中。
不出意外的话，他也会和隔壁家的二狗一样，在村里讨个婆娘，然后生几个娃娃，日出而作，日落而息，如果就这样一辈子平平安安，那就可以成功在三十岁左右的时候死在这一亩三分地里。
刚穿越过来的时候，他还奢望过会有什么外挂。
然而事到如今，经历了不知多少次的愤怒，绝望，自我开解后，他已经放弃那种不切实际的妄想了。
不过话虽如此，王平倒也没有摆烂。
二十年生活，他左右逢源，想尽办法，总算是找到了一份差事，能在养活自己的同时留下一点积蓄。
“来，大家都过来吧。”
青年道人伸手招呼，王平紧随其后，很快道观内的众人就集结起来，神色庄重地来到了后院的大堂。
大堂两侧的廊柱上，赫然是一副对联：
【地振高冈，一派溪山千古秀。】
【门朝大海，三合河水万年流。】
content_en:
Dashun 995, Changle County, Longxing County, Qiancun, Sichuan.
The winter is bitterly cold, and the bleak autumn wind has become increasingly harsh at this time, like an invisible sword, constantly slashing at the life of the earth.
However, even so, in the early morning, the leaders of the former village still bundled up in their clothes, opened the door, and walked out of the house despite the bitter cold. Some of them were determined to go up the mountain to chop firewood, and some were determined to try their luck in nearby Longxing County to see if they could find a job.
People gathered on the muddy village road.
They didn't speak, even if they were neighbors, they would just nod to each other when they met, because whenever they spoke, they would be blown into the cold wind.
The huge village was silent.
There was only the sound of the silent walking of the Guizhou leaders and the sound of hunting blown by the cold wind. The whole village seemed like a frozen beast crawling deep in the forest.
...........
After the crowd arrived at the entrance of the village, they went their separate ways. Some went to the back mountain, some went to the county seat, and some went to the north of the village.
There stands a Taoist temple.
The Taoist temple doesn't look big from the outside, it can even be said to be simple, but when you get closer, you can feel a scorching wind blowing against your face.
After walking into the Taoist temple, you can see a huge incense burner in the middle. A large number of burnt stones are put into it to light the fire, which then brings up the hot air to the sky, dispelling the coldness of the severe winter. The human voices coming from the Taoist temple make it the only living place in this severe winter.
"Ah... so comfortable!"
Several villagers from Qiancun walked into the Taoist temple and sighed happily. Then they saw a young man wearing Taoist robes walking out of the backyard.
"Is everyone here?" the young Taoist asked.
"I've met Senior Brother Xie."
The villagers saluted one after another with indescribable enthusiasm on their expressions. They intertwined the fingers of their hands to form a lotus-shaped handprint, and praised in their mouths:
"The lotus comes to the world to save all living beings."
Hearing this, the young Taoist also formed a seal with his hands, returned the salute, and then continued: "Master has been waiting for you for a long time. Come in with me."
Everyone entered the backyard like this, only to see that there were a dozen men in their prime, with a body like a calf. They obviously had meat for three meals a day, and they were practicing martial arts. They were punching and hehehehehahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahao, youthful and sweaty.
The person responsible for leading them is a young man.
I saw that he was naked from the waist up, sweat rolled down his shoulders and back, his skin showed a bronze luster in the sun, his outlines were clear, and his face was handsome and elegant.
"Junior brother, stop for a moment."
The young Taoist said loudly, but the young man did not respond. Instead, he froze in place, seeming to be lost in memories, and did not come back to his senses for a long time.
"Junior brother?" The young Taoist was a little curious when he saw this.
"...It's okay."
Wang Ping shook his head to dispel the confusion in his eyes, quickly cheered up, and said with a smile: "Master, he is back, and he wants to see us?"
"Yeah."
The young Taoist smiled and said: "Junior brother, you have been helping to organize the church members in the former village. You have worked hard without complaining and have made great contributions. The master came back just for you."
"Junior brother, your good days are coming!"
Wang Ping suddenly showed joy when he heard this.
However, deep down in his heart, his mood did not fluctuate, and he even wanted to laugh a little - what kind of good life could the ancient dynasty and feudal society have?
It is a blessing to be alive.
Twenty years ago, he also lived in this poor place called "Dashun" for twenty years and completely integrated into the life here.
If nothing else happens, he will be like the Ergou next door, asking for a wife in the village, and then giving birth to a few babies, working at sunrise and resting at sunset. If he lives a peaceful life like this, he can successfully die in this one-third of an acre of land when he is about thirty years old.
When he first traveled through time, he had extravagantly hoped that there would be some cheats.
However, now, after experiencing countless times of anger, despair, and self-liberation, he has given up on that unrealistic delusion.
But having said that, Wang Ping didn't mess up.
After twenty years of living, he tried his best to find a job, which allowed him to support himself while leaving some savings.
"Come on, everyone, come over."
The young Taoist stretched out his hand to say hello, followed closely by Wang Ping. Soon everyone in the Taoist temple gathered together and came to the lobby in the backyard with a solemn expression.
On the pillars on both sides of the lobby, there is a couplet:
[The ground shakes the high hills, and the streams and mountains are beautiful through the ages. 】
[The door faces the sea, and the Sanhe River flows for thousands of years. 】
